description: This file defines pin configuration and bias register mappings for Renesas R-Car Gen3 SoC, including drive and bias register structures, and functions to retrieve register info.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_bias_regs
methods.description: Returns pointer to the array of bias register configurations.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_drive_regs
methods.description: Returns pointer to the array of drive register configurations.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_reg_index
methods.description: Provides the register index for a given pin; always returns 0 for Gen3.
